name: quote-card-builder
description: Turn quotes, text, URLs, documents, and ideas into editable quote cards with guided editorial and visual review.

interface.shortDescription: Open a guided editor for creating quote cards.
interface.longDescription: Collect a quote, visible attribution, palette, and visual direction, then open the interactive Quote Card Builder editor. The plugin uses the canonical renderer rather than image generation, direct chat files, or a local editor.
defaultPrompt: Open Quote Card Builder and turn this quote into a card.
Find the strongest quote in this text and open the Quote Card Builder editor.
Open the Quote Card Builder editor.
